replacement.title: Video Duration Limit
replacement.definition: Constraint governing the permissible length and maximum duration of the completed UGC video.

patches.decision_note: Video duration is independently testable and changes separately from delivery and script adherence; routing findings also identify this absent Requirement.
Message 12 is an anchor for script adherence but its raw text is unavailable here; verify whether it establishes the Requirement before the current INTRODUCE at message 25.
